description: Reviews crisp-tui shell commands that change a Crisp support inbox. `crisp-tui ctl draft` writes a reply or internal note into the composer of the running TUI and never sends it. `crisp-tui cli` forwards every remaining argument to crispctl, whose reply, assign, segment, resolve, and reopen commands write immediately. Read-only control commands (ctl state, goto, screen, details, conversations, messages, drafts, read, and refresh) are not matched. ctl state is an inbox snapshot, not a resolve. The Unix-socket control protocol is not a shell command and is outside this extension. Pinned to crisp-tui 0.2.0 (ca38f362ea558cb09a82fbf3ef1aba3e6fb8692c).
name: crisp-tui command protection
saferAlternatives: Prepare text with `crisp-tui ctl draft` and let a person send it from the TUI.
